high_level_description: This image is a close-up photograph of a sliced orange, showcasing its vibrant orange flesh and the white pith surrounding it. The texture of the orange's inner surface is clearly visible, with the segments of the fruit separated by the white pith. Water droplets are scattered across the surface of the orange, glistening under the light, which adds a fresh and juicy appearance to the fruit. The background is dark, creating a stark contrast that makes the bright orange color of the fruit stand out even more vividly.
